Zenskar | Bengaluru, India (Hybrid – 2 days/week in-office) | Senior Backend Engineer

Zenskar is an AI-native revenue automation platform built to handle real-world complexity.

We raised $15M in Series A funding in April 2026, led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Shine Capital, and Rho, with participation from Rocketship, J-Ventures, Future Back Ventures by Bain & Company, and Converge.

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and build core platform systems where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable. You’ll work on distributed systems, enterprise integrations, and APIs that power zero-touch finance operations at scale.

Looking for engineers with 5–7 years of experience building production backend systems, strong system design instincts, and comfort operating in high-scale, high-complexity environments.

Tech: backend systems, distributed architecture, APIs, AWS, event-driven systems

Apply: https://evolve.keka.com/careers/applyjob/36861 Or email: nitya@zenskar.com

For more openings: https://zenskar.notion.site/careers-zenskar#29c40c1b83f180e9...
